metadata.title: Risks Loom Over Nvidia’s Fast-Growing Data Center Segment

content.text:
15 hours ago
Starting this fiscal year, Nvidia began splitting its data center sales into two groups: hyperscalers—the very large buyers like Amazon.com, Microsoft, Alphabet and Meta Platforms—and smaller customers.
While hyperscaler revenue was 56% of the $108 billion in third-quarter data center sales, the smaller group saw its sales grow by 195% since last year to $47.5 billion.
This second group contains the Asian customers who are renting Nvidia's servers out to Chinese companies, getting around export controls, and Nvidia may have to lose these customers.
